title: Options every agent harness takes
description: Composed by each harness addon's options.schema.json, which adds its own keys and rejects unknown ones with unevaluatedProperties: false.

args.description: Extra command-line arguments appended to the agent launch, each shell-quoted.

effort.description: Reasoning effort the agent runs at.

permissions.description: Permission mode: how strictly a run starts; see the addon's Security section.

sandbox.description: Sandbox lists; only valid with `permissions: 'sandbox'`. Each key set replaces its default; lists are not merged.

trusted_commands.description: Commands that run outside the sandbox.

deny_read.description: Paths the agent may not read.

allow_write.description: Paths the agent may write besides the worktree and the temporary directory.

network.description: Hosts the agent may reach; `*` allows every host.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers of a sandboxed run, in the agent's own shape; the `bakers` server is always added.

config.description: The agent's own permission configuration; required with, and only valid with, `permissions: 'custom'`.

env_deny.description: Ticket environment variable names (`*` globs) removed from the run environment; replaces the default list.
